messages:
anya: Heads up — trying to onboard Tempesta11b (int8) on canary fleet and seeing intermittent OOMs during longer generations. Repro on canary-4 when batch>1. Stack points to KV allocation failure around token ~1200.

mike: Is that a CUDA OOM or our eviction logic failing? any error snippet?

anya: CUDA OOM during alloc_tensor, snippet:```
[2026-03-22 14:02:03] ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
alloc requested=1.1GiB, free=850MiB, kv_slots=400
stack: runtime/kv_cache.c:evict_slots -> alloc_chunk
```

rachel: We onboarded the int8 artifact with prefetch=true and left max_new_tokens at 512. Int8 reduces model size but prefetch + long new tokens increases working set and fragments allocator.

jordan: Seen this before. Prefetching entire prefix + big max_new_tokens produces many transient KV allocations. Try disabling prefetch or lowering max_new_tokens as a quick mitigation.

lee: Can you paste exact request config you used to repro?

anya: Repro payload: prompt ~1.2k tokens, max_new_tokens=512, batch_size=2, prefetch=true, quant=int8, kernel=auto. Failure rate ~25-35%.

mike: For immediate canary safety set batch_size=1, max_new_tokens=256, prefetch=false in the canary policy for tempesta11b-int8. Also bump kv_eviction_threshold to 0.7 to be more aggressive with evictions.

rachel: I ran a small QA micro-run to check quality impact (200 samples):
- fp16 (batch=2, max_new=512): EM=78.4, F1=84.8
- int8 same config: EM=77.8, F1=83.9
- int8 + max_new=256: EM=77.9, F1=84.1
Looks like cutting max_new slightly recovers some metric; acceptable tradeoff.

jordan: Sounds fine. Proposal: set onboarding defaults for tempesta11b-int8 to batch_size:1, max_new_tokens:256, prefetch:false, kv_eviction_threshold:0.7 and include a note in model metadata: "avoid prefetch with long prompts or high max_new_tokens on int8 variants".

lee: Medium-term: test alternative quant recipe (per-channel clip) and allocator knobs. Two flags to try: compact_kv=true and kv_trim_on_alloc=true to reduce fragmentation. Also add allocator metrics (peak alloc, fragmentation ratio) to infra dashboards.

anya: I'll kick off a 1k-sample smoke with this patch. Planned config:```yaml
model: tempesta11b-int8
runtime: redwood-runtime-v2
batch_size: 1
max_new_tokens: 256
prefetch: false
compact_kv: true
kv_eviction_threshold: 0.7
kv_trim_on_alloc: true
```

ci-bot: Canary update queued: tempesta11b-int8 config canary-20260322-11 started. (run id: canary-20260322-11) :robot_face:

mike: If that stabilizes, add an onboarding checklist item: "frag stress: long prompt + batches 2..4, record peak CUDA alloc" and block int8 from batch>1 until frag test passes for the model.

rachel: Also attach eval diffs (QA, summarization) to the model card and show recommended defaults + known regressions in Console. That will help customers understand tradeoffs.

anya: Quick update: first 100 runs of the compact_kv + kv_trim_on_alloc config passed with zero OOMs. Will report full smoke results.

lee: Thanks. Jordan, can you open an infra ticket to add fragmentation metrics (free vs total, alloc retries, kv compaction count)? Put it behind an alert threshold so we catch regressions.

jordan: On it. Will label as P2 and link to this thread.

ci-bot: Canary run canary-20260322-11 finished: 1000/1000 tests passed, 0 OOMs, avg latency +3.2% vs int8 baseline.

rachel: Those numbers look acceptable. I'll update the onboarding PR and model card with the defaults and the frag note.

mike: I'll also add a temp alert on canary nodes for CUDA mem > 18Gi to catch early signs.

anya: Final action items: anya finish full eval and paste artifacts, mike push canary policy change, rachel update model card and attach eval diffs, jordan open infra ticket, lee follow up on quant recipe tests. We'll close once PR merged and policy live.

jordan: Thanks everyone. Close when done. :white_check_mark:
